Neuroport Security

All Neuroports possess built-in firewall security.

Netrunners with Interface Rank 1-2 must succeed at a DV6 Interface Check before attempting to establish a QuickHack connection.

Netrunners with Interface Rank 3+ bypass this security automatically.

Failure does not alert the target.

If the Netrunner is forcefully removed from the Neuroport they are considered to have Unsafely Jacked Out.

After being Unsafely Jacked Out, the Netrunner may not attempt to reconnect to that target for 60 minutes.
